<ApiTitle method="post" title="Create Embedded Signing URL" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/turbosign/documents/{documentId}/signing-url"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a signing URL for one signer of a sent document, to open, redirect to or show in an iframe in your app. Request it when the signer is ready and never store it; for external identity verification, pass your provider's result in `identityAssertion`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>
